description: niubisile-wq/pcc-power-grid-transformation: Initial code release (v1.0.0) is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors niubisile-wq. Initial public code release for the manuscript: "Identity Preservation in Power-Grid Model Transformation: Proof-Carrying Canonicalization for N–1 Contingency Analysis and AC Optimal Power Flow." This release contains: the reference PCC contract and signed canonicalizer; frozen benchmark protocols; N–1 and AC-OPF experiment scripts; semantic and protocol integrity audits; CGMES interoperability adapters, validation scripts, and tests. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
